text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, a large-scale marathon was being 
held in the city—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The water station is over here! Please 
make sure to hydrate regularly according 
to your condition!

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Head
text_block_list.text:
Man, it was a huge help that you all 
volunteered to help run things. Thank you!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, don't worry about it. You looked like 
you were having a tough time, so I wanted 
to help out.

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Head
text_block_list.text:
Ah... several of the volunteer staff 
members just happened to call in sick at 
the same time, you see...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...? But from here on out, we'll 
give it our all to help you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yup yup. I might be a bit of a mess, 
but... these two are super competent at 
their jobs—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Feel free to sit back and leave everything 
to me, okay? Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Runner
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...!? Th-This is... Dammit! And here I 
thought I was being careful!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah—did your leg cramp up? If so, please 
rest over here in the shade.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, she must be low on fluids—and 
electrolytes too... I'll go get a banana. 
Please hold on, okay?"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Oh right, how about a quick massage? I'm 
pretty good at it. Would you take a seat 
there?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Wow. That's amazing, Miracle-senpai. 
You handled that flawlessly!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Right? Oh, come to think of it... 
Miracle-chan's studying to become a 
physical therapist, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
So that explains the swift response, huh. 
...Guess I better put in a little effort 
myself~

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...I know! I'll go buy some bananas! That 
way, Miracle-senpai can focus completely 
on what's right in front of her—!"

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Head
text_block_list.text:
Whew, thank you! Thanks to everyone's 
help, we wrapped up without any major 
trouble!!

text_block_list.name: Executive Committee Head
text_block_list.text:
Especially you, K.S. Miracle-san! Helping 
with the injured was a huge lifesaver! 
Thanks to you, the medical team could work 
with composure!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, you worked so hard~. MVP? BOAT? 
Something like that~.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you. Though, I only did what I 
could.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Miracle-senpai! Great work out there~! 
You were so amazingly active, it totally 
blew me away—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I wish I could've worked even harder, like 
Miracle-senpai did... Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Aha, why would you say that?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Because Dants was the one who performed 
the best today, wasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Whaaat!? No, no, no! Compared to you, 
Senpai, I'm nowhere near that~!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...You're the one who got those bananas 
for me, right? That was a huge help."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's not all. She was preparing wet 
towels, running out to buy supplies we 
were running low on... even telling staff 
who looked unwell to take a break—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Your support for the 'supporters' was 
flawless. Seeing that made me think—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It made me feel like I have to do my best, 
just like Dants.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: So, good work. —You really did your best.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um, well... Eheh... Ahaha. Oh dear, what 
should I say?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...I feel all warm and fuzzy inside! 
Thank you so much! Ehehe."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. You're wonderful, Miracle-chan. 
Always paying attention to things like 
that.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's eat~! There was pizza 
over there! The kind with sausage stuffed 
in the crust!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At dusk. Walking through town, I ran into 
K.S. Miracle and the others on their way 
back to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
—So they treated me to pizza and stuff. I 
ended up eating a bit too much, haha...
choice_data_list: You worked really hard. Great job!
Did you get to eat lots of delicious food?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all. Someone like me really 
hasn't done anything—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"No, Miracle-senpai tried her absolute 
hardest! So please make sure to give her 
lots of praise too, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh, Dants?
choice_data_list:
Awesome! Good job! I really respect how 
you take action for others!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Even you, Trainer... Fufu. Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'm glad I worked so hard.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Relative to my standards, I 
mean—compared to how I usually am, that 
is.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Besides... hehe. Hishi Miracle and Dantsu 
look like they're enjoying it so much.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Just watching that made me feel happy, or 
rather... it was so much fun. Truly."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"...Listen to this, Trainer! Miracle-chan 
beams with a happy smile every time we 
stuff our faces!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"So I ended up ordering pudding that 
wasn't even in the plan! Jeez, eating out 
with you is kinda dangerous, you know?!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... If we get the chance, let's go 
again, okay?
